hero.eyebrow: Built-in CLI. Ready for your AI agent.
meta.title: PecoFence: free, open-source desktop organizer for Windows 11 and 10
meta.description: A free, open-source Stardock Fences alternative for Windows 11 and 10. It groups desktop icons into glass fences and sorts new files automatically. Press a shortcut and type to find a file. Open and Save dialogs can jump to the folder open in File Explorer. Your AI agent can set it all up.
hero.headline: Make room
hero.text: A free, open-source desktop organizer for Windows 11 and 10. It keeps your icons in glass panels and sorts new files by your rules. Press one shortcut and type to find a file. Open and Save dialogs can jump to the folder open in File Explorer.
hero.download_note: Microsoft Store edition, signed by Microsoft. Or the portable ZIP for x64: no account, no installer. Apache 2.0 license.
hero.panels_alt: Projects, inspiration and everyday files, each in its own Liquid Glass fence.
watch.title: Watch the 30-second trailer
watch.text: Sort files, switch projects, then ask your AI to set up the desktop with pecofence-cli. Half a minute, original soundtrack, no voiceover, English on-screen text.
features.heading: Everything in its right place.
features.intro: Each feature comes with a short animation of how to use it. The manual walks through every step.
feature.search.title: Find it as you type
feature.search.text: Press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> <kbd>Alt</kbd> <kbd>Space</kbd> and type. Matching files and folders in your fences show up at once, and <kbd>Enter</kbd> opens one. Chinese names can be found by pinyin too. Everything is a free file search tool: turn on Everything search in Settings, and the whole computer is searched as well.
feature.dialog.title: The right folder in Open and Save
feature.dialog.text: In an Open or Save dialog, switch to File Explorer and back, and the dialog jumps to the folder open there. <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> <kbd>G</kbd> jumps there too, and a click on a folder fence goes to that fence's folder. It is off by default, and PecoFence offers it the first time it can help. Even with it off, <kbd>Enter</kbd> on a Peek search result works with the dialog: an Open dialog opens the file, a Save dialog goes to its folder.
feature.groups.title: Make a fence
feature.groups.text: Drag files in. Resize the fence and snap it beside the others.
feature.portal.title: Keep a folder close
feature.portal.text: A live folder on your desktop. Open subfolders and watch changes arrive as they happen. The mouse's back button goes up a folder and forward goes back in.
feature.tabs.title: Tabs for related fences
feature.tabs.text: From project files to inspiration. Just switch tabs.
feature.peek.title: Your desktop, one shortcut away
feature.peek.text: Press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> <kbd>Alt</kbd> <kbd>Space</kbd> to bring your fences above the current app. Open a file with a double-click and Peek ends on its own. Press <kbd>Esc</kbd> to go back.
feature.hide.title: Clear some space
feature.hide.text: Double-click the desktop to hide every fence, and again to bring them back. Roll a fence up to its title when you need the room.
feature.rules.title: Less sorting
feature.rules.text: Rules based on file type, name, wildcard, age or size put new items in the right fence. Files stay where they are on disk.
features.guide: Step by step in the manual
tools.heading: Tools, when you want them
tools.intro: Each tool has its own switch in Settings › Tools. Notes are on by default, the clock and script fences are off. A tool that is off does not run. Notes, clocks and script fences move, snap and roll up like any fence.
tool.note.title: Notes and to-dos
tool.note.text: A few lines of text on the desktop. Click to edit them; a line that starts with [ ] becomes a to-do you tick with a click.
tool.clock.title: Clock and date
tool.clock.text: The time in large digits with the date and weekday, in the format of your Windows region. Seconds if you want them.
tool.script.title: Script fence
tool.script.text: Runs your own PowerShell, Python, batch or JavaScript script and shows what it prints: every 1 minute to 3 hours, like the ready-made weather example, or kept running and updated every few seconds, like the PC status example. Rows can open a link, run a program or tick a to-do when you click them. PecoFence itself does not go online for the fence; only your script does.
details.heading: Small details that add up
detail.glass.title: Glass that fits your wallpaper
detail.glass.text: Fluent and Liquid Glass themes, light and dark modes, per-fence colors, opacity and icon tinting.
detail.files.title: Familiar file handling
detail.files.text: File Explorer context menus, drag and drop, copy and paste, multi-select, thumbnails, and icon, list or details views.
detail.space.title: Space when you need it
detail.space.text: Roll a fence up to its title bar. Hover to expand. Lock a layout once you like it.
detail.back.title: A way back
detail.back.text: Layout snapshots, daily backups, configuration import and export, and swapping fences between displays.
detail.footprint.title: A small footprint
detail.footprint.text: A native Rust application that uses only about 2 to 5 MB of memory at rest in Task Manager. The settings panel loads WebView2 only when you open it.
detail.safe.title: Your files stay put
detail.safe.text: Automatic rules only change which fence shows a file. Moves you start yourself work exactly as in File Explorer.
agents.heading: Your desktop. Configured by your AI.
agents.text: Tell your AI agent how you want your desktop to work. The bundled pecofence-cli lets Claude Code, Codex and Cursor read your current setup and apply changes directly in PecoFence.
agents.point1: Configure it in your own words. Change themes, transparency, icon sizes and global settings, or adjust every fence at once.
agents.point2: Organize once. Keep it organized. Create project fences, arrange icons and add rules that sort new files automatically.
agents.point3: Save a setup you like. Use snapshots for fence layouts and configuration export/import for settings, rules and layouts.
agents.terminal_label: Example conversation with a coding agent
agents.prompt: Put my desktop PDFs in a Docs fence, keep new PDFs there, switch to dark mode and make the fences more transparent.
agents.reply: Exporting your configuration and saving the layout, then applying the rules and appearance changes.
download.heading: Get PecoFence
download.step1: Download the latest pecofence-v<version>-x64-portable.zip from the releases page.
download.step2: Extract the whole ZIP into a folder and run pecofence.exe.
download.step3: Start organizing. The tray icon opens Settings whenever you need it.
download.winget: Prefer the command line? winget install DayuanJiang.PecoFence installs the same build and skips the SmartScreen prompt.
download.installer: Prefer an installer? pecofence-v<version>-x64-setup.exe from the releases page installs PecoFence for your Windows user, with a Start menu entry and an uninstaller.
download.first_run: The first launch creates four fences in your language: Programs, Folders, Files and documents, and Desktop. Your desktop icons come back when you exit.
download.req2: Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime for the Settings window. Windows 11 already includes it; Windows 10 may need to install it.
download.req4: Portable builds are unsigned. If Windows SmartScreen appears on first launch, choose More info, then Run anyway. Installing from the Microsoft Store or through winget avoids the prompt.
download.req5: Optional: Peek search finds files on the whole computer with the free Everything by voidtools; Settings › General › Peek installs version 1.5 in one click. Script fences run PowerShell and batch scripts as they are; Python and JavaScript scripts need Python or Node.js installed.
footer.tagline: Made for a desktop you enjoy coming back to.
footer.copyright: PecoFence contributors. Not affiliated with Stardock.
agents.start_title: Try it with your AI agent
agents.start_text: Open PecoFence, then paste this request into your AI coding agent:
agents.setup: The CLI is included. The Microsoft Store edition adds pecofence-cli to PATH. With the portable ZIP, give your agent the path to pecofence-cli.exe.
agents.starter: Use pecofence-cli to configure my desktop. First read pecofence-cli skill and pecofence-cli describe, then inspect my current settings and fences. Back up my configuration before changes. Switch to dark mode and make all fences more transparent.
agents.contract: Built for agents and scripts: describe exposes the command catalog and JSON Schemas; skill prints the agent guide. JSON results report what changed, and structured application errors help the agent choose its next step.
